set.body:
Confirmed baseline failure: S15 task-a estimate is 7.58460388165137 versus historical R 0.7497435200650893; task-a-minus-b standard error is 0.051038620532185136 versus 0.0005583887446371466. Identical without the ownership patch. Nuisance selection/structural checks pass.
Files: tools/r-parity/generate_realistic_nuisance_receipt.R and finalize_realistic_nuisance_receipt.py; RealisticNuisanceRFixture.scala or a corrected variant; MixedBlockNuisanceScenarioSuite.scala; scenario fixtures/manifest and approved reference-lock registration.
Follow the corrected-reference pattern established by P4.4l and docs/audits/spmg-correction.md. Use REALISTIC_NUISANCE_RECEIPT_OUT/REALISTIC_NUISANCE_SCALA_OUT for temporary generation. Preserve the historical receipt. Independently construct corrected task columns plus the unchanged deterministic confounds in R; check retained/dropped columns, full X, rank, beta and covariance in that order. Distinguish raw beta scale from response amplitude; do not apply an arbitrary post-hoc scale factor because the canonical shape also changed.
Acceptance: both S12 and S15 in MixedBlockNuisanceScenarioSuite pass on fitJVM and fitJS with the corrected source-bound reference. Keep the duplicate/constant/near-collinearity policies and existing numerical tolerances. Active receipts regenerate/check coherently, historical ones remain auditable, and the acceptance ledger cites the corrected source. A remaining discrepancy is a release blocker, not an accepted caveat.
set.title: P4.4m: qualify the realistic-nuisance receipt against corrected SPMG coordinates
